module: "Part Properties" window of the Static Editor. It shows in a generic inspector the scalar (non-table) properties of the table selected in the editor (vEditor.propertyTableEditTarget), and writes changes directly into that table. Numbers are editable as float, booleans as checkbox, everything else as string.
notes: The keys '__astNodeIdx' and '__schemaProcessed' as well as all table values are ignored.
The inspector is created with editor/api/genericInspector; the setter writes newValue into lastEditTarget[fieldName] (so it modifies the in-memory JBeam data).
Minor bug: an edited string is written back as is (string) even if the original field was a number converted to float; only the field value changes, the field type is not revalidated.
The type field of an integer is 'float' (every number is treated as float).

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: rebuilds the field list when the edit target changes, then draws the generic inspector.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook called at initialization: registers the window (500x400, vehicleEditor tool) and creates the generic inspector with its setter.
